current_structure.title: Understanding the Tekton Results retention policy

sections.title: Understanding the Tekton Results retention policy

jobs.job_statement: Understand how Tekton Results retention works
jobs.user_goal: Learn the fundamentals of retention policy management
line_references: → Lines 63-66: Abstract explaining Retention Policy Agent and config map
→ Lines 66-67: Explanation of retention policy behavior
→ Lines 114-135: Table of retention configuration fields
jobs.gap_analysis: Content is well-structured with clear conceptual explanation and reference material. The assembly provides a good overview of retention policy fundamentals.
jobs.consolidation_opportunity: None. Content should remain as foundational understanding material.

jobs.user_goal: Set up default retention behavior for all results
line_references: → Lines 68-112: Sample YAML configuration with TektonConfig
→ Lines 114-135: Field descriptions for runAt, defaultRetention, maxRetention
jobs.gap_analysis: Missing procedural guidance. The document provides reference examples but lacks step-by-step instructions for configuring retention settings. Users have the 'what' but not the 'how'.
jobs.consolidation_opportunity: Create a procedure module for configuring basic retention settings, referencing the existing configuration examples.

jobs.user_goal: Learn how to create targeted retention rules based on specific criteria
line_references: → Lines 147-148: Abstract explaining policies field and evaluation order
→ Lines 150-176: Table of policy fields and selectors
→ Lines 219-225: Examples of how policies apply to different Results
jobs.gap_analysis: Good conceptual coverage with clear reference examples. The selector logic (AND conditions) is well explained.
jobs.consolidation_opportunity: None. The concept and reference material work well together to explain fine-grained policies.

jobs.user_goal: Configure different retention periods for specific namespaces
line_references: → Lines 178-217: Example config map with multiple namespace-based policies
→ Lines 221-225: Examples of namespace-specific policy application
jobs.gap_analysis: Lacks procedural guidance for creating and applying namespace-based policies. Users need step-by-step instructions.
jobs.consolidation_opportunity: Create a procedure module for configuring namespace-based retention policies.

jobs.job_statement: Create status and label-based retention policies
jobs.user_goal: Configure retention rules based on pipeline run outcomes and labels
line_references: → Lines 164-169: matchLabels and matchAnnotations field descriptions
→ Lines 191-200: Example of critical failures retention policy combining status and labels
→ Lines 221-222: Example of failed Result retention in production

current_approaches.title: Selector fields for labels, annotations, and statuses

jobs.gap_analysis: Reference material is comprehensive but lacks procedural guidance for implementing status and label-based policies. Users need practical steps for common scenarios (e.g., retaining failed runs longer).
jobs.consolidation_opportunity: Create a procedure module for configuring advanced retention policies using labels, annotations, and statuses.
